notes.title: RealityMinds, full screen support, improved operation for controllers!
notes.notes:
Thank you for enjoying RealityMinds.
In consideration of the operation of Reality and SteamDeck, we have made the following improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40783582/56a5fd832b0b4897eabef9ad47335d7a73d16fef.jpg[/img]

■improvements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40783582/828d499920d50aabffda5300c1733e54f16f0a25.jpg[/img]

Added "Start in Full Screen" option and "Shutdown" in the title and "Leave Game" command in the menu.
　Full screen status will be saved from the next startup.

Controller call function is now supported.
　Progress Hint: L1
　Sub-event hint: L2
　Move (released under certain conditions):R1
　Formation (released under certain conditions):R2

Note that volume, cutin, voices, difficulty, and other settings may change due to the update of "config.rpgsave".
Please check the value of your options after the update.

We hope you continue to enjoy RealityMinds.

notes.title: "RealityMinds" is now available!
notes.notes:
"RealityMinds" is now available!

Dear all JRPG lovers!

“You know what? If you stay positive, things will work out in the end!”

A young aspiring soldier and a mysterious girl switch bodies.
An RPG with a ripple effect that changes the minds of everyone involved.

[previewyoutube=osx7GgAiolo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Original characters, enemies, maps, and event illustrations. 6 playable characters, 61 enemies, and over 140 maps all conceived by creator Yutaro Tsuyuki.

The following data (1), (2), and (3) will be released as you progress through the game.

(1)Scenario Book
This is a collection of dialogues that can be referred to in both English and Japanese. It contains supplementary notes by the author and points of interest during translation.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40783582/21b5a147049b818d3416b1b0cea7fba09596faa6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40783582/473cae5c3117692e4256c75a99a51e9c3e35e08d.png[/img][/url]

(2)The Making of a Portrait Illustration
This is a collection of illustration data that allows you to feel the production process of illustrations in five stages, including rough and before coloring.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40783582/43ef5ba33bf92ac57b2316379ec4996345d40cb4.png[/img]

(3)Illustrations posted on SNS
This is the original data of the limited edition illustrations posted on SNS from the time of the original version production to the present.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40783582/4ac98515e4d7438df99b73720587c5538bcc18c4.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40783582/0bc351ccfafd364044c66c4f7d8967f8ccdc586b.png[/img]

(4)DLC: "Official Visual Book","Popular Fantasy Monster Pack"
An official visual book(Janpanese Only) containing unpublished illustrations and setting materials, as well as monster materials that will appear in the game, will be released as DLC.
